subject: MAP: DPA, SOC 2 evidence & retention — final questions
messages:
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@tidebank.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@tidebank.com, luis.moreno@tidebank.com
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2023 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final questions to close MAP — DPA & retention

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for walking us through the MAP yesterday. Procurement has three last items before we route for signature:

1) DPA: we need to confirm the proposed data deletion timeline for customer PII and logs (app & audit logs). Is Redwood open to 365-day retention with a 30-day deletion buffer following contract termination?
2) SOC 2: we asked for a current SOC 2 report — will a summary + controls matrix suffice for our security team, or do you provide the full report under an NDA?
3) SIG/CAIQ: we received your spreadsheet but have a handful of follow-ups around key management and access logs. Can someone on your security team annotate the CAIQ answers?

We aim to sign the agreement this week if we can get concrete answers (and the DPA). Our target go-live is 3/28.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager, TideBank
ann a@tidebank.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2023 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final questions to close MAP — DPA & retention

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below; Neha from our security team is looping in to add detail.

Summary answers:
- DPA / retention: Redwood supports configurable retention windows. We can agree to 365 days for customer PII and logs with a 30-day deletion buffer after contract termination. We'll provide the DPA draft with the specific retention clause and optional 90/730 alternatives if TideBank needs to carve specific logs out.
- SOC 2: we can share a SOC 2 Type II summary and a controls matrix immediately. Full report is available under NDA — we'll send the NDA link if you want the complete artifact.
- SIG/CAIQ: Neha will attach the annotated CAIQ spreadsheet and call out any open items (KMS escrow, HSM details, audit log retention).

MAP / timeline proposal (to meet 3/28 go-live):
1) Tue 3/14 — Security Q&A annotated CAIQ + SOC2 summary shared (Neha)
2) Wed 3/15 — Procurement review DPA draft; send back redlines by EOD Thu 3/16
3) Fri 3/17 — Legal alignment & final DocuSign ready by Mon 3/20
4) 3/20–3/24 — onboarding & staging access; production cut on 3/28

If this timeline looks tight on your end, confirm the critical path item (DPA redline or residency) and we can extend one-week.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft_TideBank_20230315.docx
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/TideBank/MAP-SIG-CAIQ

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive

Anna — looping in from Commercial leadership. Appreciate the clear asks — two commercial items to confirm:

1) If TideBank signs the final DPA and SOW by end-of-day 2023-03-18, Redwood can offer one month of platform credits (to offset onboarding) and lock current pricing for 12 months.
2) If the DPA redlines are minimal (non-substantial), we can proceed with DocuSign on Mon 3/20 per Karthik's timeline; if you require EU residency or Private deployment, that will shift the go-live by ~3–5 weeks.

Can you confirm procurement's preferred signature route (DocuSign vs. in-person countersign)? Also, Anna, if you confirm the go/no-go for EU residency by Thu 3/16 EOD, we'll prioritize a short impact assessment from Engineering.

- EU residency: TideBank requires EU residency for message-level logs (yes). We need clarity on whether Redwood's hosted offering can partition logs to EU regions (or else we'll need Private deployment).
- We'll review the CAIQ annotations today and return any remaining redlines on the DPA by Fri 3/17 EOD.

If Redwood can confirm EU-residency options for logs by EOD Thu 3/16, we should be able to stay on the shorter timeline and sign by 3/18. If not, please let us know the Private deployment lead time.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Anna
